title: A second ork stop does not cancel the first
lead: From the S17 review, not fixed. Running ork stop twice on one run cancels the first stop instead of being a no-op.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: From the S17 review, not fixed. Running ork stop twice on one run cancels the first stop instead of being a no-op.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A second stop on a run already stopping returns without cancelling the first.
- Stop on a finished run is an error naming the state.
